retained_findings.details: Review found that naive prefix removal could collapse index.html.md backlinks into the home route. Replacement is restricted to exact index.html# targets; the dotted-page regression passes.

Definitions before a call site now retain source-order anchors but order backlinks by the first footnote call site. A regression covers a later source marker preceding an earlier footnote definition in reading order.
The separate WebKit overflow and documentation hydration findings remain open; later feature acceptance does not close them.

limits: Public rc.6 and production hosting are unchanged.
One subentry level and plain definitions; no automatic indexing, locale-aware collation, rich definitions or compressed page ranges.
BibTeX/custom CSL, multilingual/RTL print, Next-image PDFs, richer book editions and remaining installation work remain open.
Live providers and production-domain migration remain deferred.
No claim of zero bugs or complete 1.0.
